ui.s: Reset all options to their default values?
All current settings, including the hotkey and module switches, will be replaced by the defaults. The change takes effect after Apply.
These options take effect after a game restart:
session only (not written to the file)
abnormality {0} not loaded: {1}. The day goes on without it; SaveGuard keeps the old save.
abnormality {0} loaded with an error in {1}; it may misbehave. The game goes on.
{0} loaded partially: {1}. Parts of this mod may not work; the other mods loaded normally.
The last session closed unexpectedly (last record {0}) during: {1}, since {4}. Last error at {3}: {2}.
BaseMod (LMM) {0} is not supported: NailOptimization is made for BaseMod {1}. Stable work cannot be guaranteed.

option.name: Heal effect limiter
option.desc: Limits heal and sanity recovery effects.

option.name: Damage effect limiter
option.desc: Limits damage popups and removes old blood splashes.

option.name: Effect pooling
option.desc: Damage popups are reused instead of created and destroyed.

option.name: Mod data load guard
option.desc: A broken mod data file is skipped and logged instead of breaking the whole load. A missing mod language falls back to English.

option.name: Mod load problem warnings
option.desc: A warning button on the title and in the day lists mod problems with the mod folder: code that failed to load or start, data files and abnormalities that had to be skipped, and mod patches the guards switched off.

option.name: Partial loading of broken mod code
option.desc: A mod DLL that needs a missing or later-loaded library loads what it can instead of stopping the code of every later mod. The mod is named in the warning list. Works for mods loaded after NailOptimization.

option.name: Day load survives broken abnormalities
option.desc: An abnormality whose mod script is missing or crashes is skipped (or kept with an error) at day load instead of stopping the load. The mod and abnormality are named in the warning list.

option.name: Warn about an unsupported BaseMod version
option.desc: If BaseMod (LMM) is not version 1.3.9, the warning list names it and opens once on the title screen.

option.name: Name the cause of the last crash
option.desc: The last step before the game closed with an error (mod being loaded, scene, day, last error) is kept in Logs/LastSession.txt. At the next start it is named in the warning list, which opens once on the title screen.

option.name: Repair broken mod data
option.desc: Instead of skipping, fixes common errors in memory (a non-number level becomes 0, a gift without a position gets an empty one). Files on disk stay unchanged. Needs the load guard.

option.name: Save guard
option.desc: Save files are copied to SaveBackups before they are overwritten; a save that failed to load is not overwritten. The log names missing mods.

option.name: No overwrite after a failed load
option.desc: After a failed load the save file is not written until it loads again; progress of that session is not saved. Needs the save guard.

option.name: Load without removed mods
option.desc: Data of removed mods is taken out on load, so the rest of the save loads. The original stays in SaveStash; the data returns with the mod. Needs the save guard.

option.name: Backups per save file
option.desc: Copies of each save file kept in SaveBackups. 0 = none. A copy made after a sudden loss of data is never deleted.

option.name: Bamboo-hatted Kim
option.desc: Fixes double buff ticks, repeated icon and sound loads and the tassel buff.

option.name: Cauldron
option.desc: Minion animation events no longer throw errors.

option.name: Chaofeng
option.desc: The slowing wind no longer makes units walk backwards; its damage no longer throws on a kill.

option.name: Over Armor Twilight
option.desc: Agent deaths no longer log an error.

option.name: YaZi
option.desc: Agent deaths while WhiteNight is in the facility no longer log an error.

option.name: kekesi_AddRoom
option.desc: The department panel no longer logs a layer error.

option.name: Acacia
option.desc: The bullet check no longer throws when the bullet touches something that is not a unit.

option.name: Elysia RiskLevel
option.desc: The creature check no longer throws every frame for a creature with a missing part.

option.name: KingOfGreedWeapon Enhance
option.desc: The weapon no longer throws when its wearer is hit between passages.

option.name: Pinel Luti's Creature
option.desc: The work text check no longer throws in every containment unit each tick (about 2 ms per frame).

option.name: Special EGO attack stuck (remake weapons)
option.desc: EGO weapons with their own Spine attack (kygi123 remakes and similar): when the attack animation never plays, the agent no longer stands still for about 100 s and then walks in battle stance; the attack ends after 1 s. A playing attack is never touched.

option.name: Day restart during the Hell Train kills employees
option.desc: Restarting the day while Express Train to Hell departs no longer kills employees of the reloaded day: they no longer start dead with their EGO lost.

option.name: Twilight suit error before day setup
option.desc: The Twilight suit's damage bonus no longer throws an error when it is asked before the day set the suit up (a suit given during the day by a mod).

option.name: We Can Change Anything: agent invisible after work
option.desc: An agent who leaves We Can Change Anything alive is visible again and is no longer killed at the end of the day; the machine closes as after a death.

option.name: CENSORED: sacrifice stays out of control
option.desc: The employee chosen as CENSORED's sacrifice gets control back when CENSORED escapes before he arrives, instead of standing out of control until the day ends.

option.name: Happy Teddy: agent dies if the day ends during the hug
option.desc: Rule change. An agent caught in Happy Teddy's hug when the day ends dies, as the hug would have ended. In the game he survives. Restart and return to title are not affected.

option.name: Lower Central Command: continued-service bonus
option.desc: Rule change. Agents of the lower Central Command team get the continued-service stat bonus that the upper team gets.

option.name: Yin and Yang dragon passes the apostles
option.desc: Rule change. The Yin and Yang dragon no longer flips the health of WhiteNight's apostles, as it already spares WhiteNight.

option.name: Void Dream: employees stay asleep or frozen
option.desc: Each employee put to sleep by Void Dream is released by his own wake-up animation, or after 8 s if it never plays, instead of staying frozen and invincible until he dies at day end. The cry hits every unit in the hallway, not only those before the first downed one.

option.name: Department expanded twice in one day
option.desc: Cancel pressed after confirming a department expansion no longer lets the same expansion be confirmed again.

option.name: Clicks taken for a drag
option.desc: A click that moved the mouse a little still selects or gives the move order instead of being taken for a drag. A drag cut off by switching windows no longer blocks later clicks.

option.name: Agent plate flicker on hover
option.desc: The agent name plate no longer flickers when the mouse is over an agent and the enlarged plate covers the cursor.

option.name: Map drag freezes during camera shake
option.desc: Dragging the map with the right or middle mouse button keeps following the mouse while the camera shakes from hits, instead of freezing and jumping.

option.name: Panicking agent stuck on the way
option.desc: A panicking agent sent to open a containment unit walks on after an interrupted walk.

option.name: Fixes for other mods
option.desc: Fixes known errors of installed mods; each fix works only when its mod is loaded. The list appears in Mod fixes after a restart.

option.name: Celestial Bunny
option.desc: The normal time mode is turned off: it threw errors every frame and changed animation speeds in its room.

option.name: FEW and Elysia risk levels
option.desc: No error every frame for empty abnormality slots on the preparation screen.

option.name: Starflare
option.desc: Suit notes and creature movement no longer throw.

option.name: Missing animation clips
option.desc: A mod animation clip missing from its skeleton is skipped instead of throwing every frame.

option.name: Train Ego: Hell Train gift
option.desc: A hit is no longer lost when the target has a similar buff.

option.name: Persephone gifts on death
option.desc: Gifts of a dead agent in the full set vanish with the body instead of hanging in the air.

option.name: TieTheTree armor icon
option.desc: The armor buff icon is loaded once instead of from disk for every buff (a lag every 6-7 s).

option.name: Harmony label on dead agents
option.desc: The weapon's note staff is hidden while its agent is dead.

option.name: Tooltip at the start of the day
option.desc: A tooltip shown at day start is closed.

option.name: Effects on killed child creatures
option.desc: Mod effects on a killed child creature are removed.

option.name: Old days in game events
option.desc: Timers and scripts of earlier days are unsubscribed at day start, so they no longer stay in memory or run every tick.

option.name: Old days in mod lists
option.desc: At day start, entries of earlier days are removed from mod lists that never clear them.

option.name: Same effect names
option.desc: Two mods with the same effect folder name each show their own effect.

option.name: List type crash (experimental)
option.desc: A mod built for a newer .NET that passes a list of one unit type where a list of another is expected no longer closes the game without an error. Such places are found in the mod code at start and listed in the log. Experimental, off by default: some mod lists closed the game at start with it on.

option.name: List type crash: all methods
option.desc: Also fixes such places inside a method with foreach, using or try (for example Krau Deluge). This loads 12Harmony, which then builds the patches of all mods. Needs 12Harmony.dll in the game Managed folder; without it these places stay unfixed. On by default; it also lets the ToyFactory log and Invalidum sound fixes apply.

option.name: 12Harmony hint on the title
option.desc: Once on the title screen: lists the fixes that are off because 12Harmony is not loaded. Switched off after it was shown.

option.name: Day end guard
option.desc: A creature that throws at the end of the day (for example Invalidum with an escaped creature outside the hallways) no longer stops the day end: the result screen still opens and the error is logged once.

option.name: Missing attribute in a mod class
option.desc: A mod class with an attribute this game lacks no longer logs an error when added.

option.name: Buffs changed during a hit
option.desc: A buff that adds or removes buffs while damage is counted no longer loses the hit.

option.name: Black Swan reflection
option.desc: Black Swan no longer reflects damage to herself endlessly (a stack overflow).

option.name: White fixer reflection
option.desc: The White fixer no longer reflects damage endlessly while praying (a game freeze).

option.name: Creature splash attacks
option.desc: A creature's splash or piercing attack no longer stops at its first target.

option.name: Patch guard
option.desc: A mod patch that throws the same error many times within 10 s is skipped until the game closes and logged with the mod id. Can turn off a feature of that mod.

option.name: Patch guard: errors before skip
option.desc: Identical errors within 10 s before a patch is skipped.

option.name: Loop guard
option.desc: A method of another mod (not a patch) that throws the same error many times within 10 s is skipped until the game closes, if it returns nothing, and logged. Can turn off a feature of that mod.

option.name: Heal effect cooldown
option.desc: Game seconds between heal effects of one type on one agent. 0 = no cooldown.

option.name: Heal effects per frame
option.desc: Most heal effects in one frame.

option.name: Heal effects per second
option.desc: Most heal effects per second.

option.name: Skip empty heals
option.desc: No effect when the heal changes nothing.

option.name: Damage popups per frame
option.desc: Most damage popups in one frame.

option.name: Damage popups per second
option.desc: Most damage popups per second.

option.name: Damage popup pool size
option.desc: Most pooled damage popups. 0 = no pooling.

option.name: Blood splashes per passage
option.desc: Blood splashes at once in a passage; the oldest is removed first. 0 = no limit.

option.name: Blood lifetime
option.desc: Game seconds before a splash is removed. 0 = never.

option.name: Restart popup animation
option.desc: A reused popup plays its animation from the start.

option.name: Cleanup interval
option.desc: Seconds between checks for expired splashes.

option.name: Destroy removed splashes
option.desc: On: removed splashes are destroyed. Off: they are hidden (use it if MissingReferenceException appears).

option.name: Save changes to the file
option.desc: Changes are written to NailOptimization.cfg.txt. Off: they last until the game closes.

option.name: Check file for edits
option.desc: Seconds between checks of the config file for outside edits. 0 = never.

option.name: Open with a key
option.desc: The hotkey opens and closes this window.

option.name: Interface key
option.desc: Click, then press a key. Esc cancels. Takes effect after Apply.

option.name: Show tooltips
option.desc: A description appears when the mouse rests on an option.

option.name: Tooltip delay
option.desc: Seconds before a tooltip appears.

option.name: Pool hit particles
option.desc: Hit particles are reused. Check hit effects by eye.

option.name: Particles pooled per variant
option.desc: Pooled particles per damage type and defense level. 0 = no pooling.

option.name: Write log
option.desc: Info and warnings go to NailOptimization.log. Errors are always written.

option.name: Force open with hotkey
option.desc: The hotkey opens this window even during loading and day transitions. Debug only.

option.name: Dump particle prefabs
option.desc: Writes the components of hit particle prefabs to the log once.

option.name: Advanced log
option.desc: Own log in the Logs folder instead of Log.txt, with a column of warnings, errors and mod file problems. Needs the log window.

option.name: Log window
option.desc: Log window, opened by the Logs button on the title and day screens.

option.name: Lines kept per tab
option.desc: Lines kept per tab; more lines use more memory.

option.name: File check interval (ms)
option.desc: Milliseconds between checks for new log lines.

option.name: Hide harmless errors
option.desc: Known harmless Unity errors are written as short INFO lines and are not counted.

option.name: Day screen button
option.desc: Window button in the day screen under the mission panel.

option.name: FPS counter
option.desc: FPS above the energy bar: simple, with average/min/max, or full.

option.name: Hide agent titles
option.desc: Hides the title under agents. Visual only.

option.name: Hide clerk names
option.desc: Hides clerk names.

option.name: Day button size
option.desc: Size of the day screen button.

option.name: Performance overlay and profiler
option.desc: F3 shows FPS, frame time and memory graphs; Shift+F3 records a profiler session to Logs/Profiler.log.

option.name: Overlay corner
option.desc: 0 top left, 1 top right, 2 bottom left, 3 bottom right.

option.name: Overlay size
option.desc: Overlay size multiplier.

option.name: Write Logs/Perf.log
option.desc: While the overlay or profiler runs, one line per second and a SPIKE line per slow frame go to Logs/Perf.log.

option.name: Spike threshold (ms)
option.desc: A frame this long or longer is logged as SPIKE.

option.name: Boot profile (diagnostic)
option.desc: Logs the time of every assembly load until the first frame, to measure how long each mod takes to start. Off for normal play.

option.name: Summary interval (s)
option.desc: Seconds between profiler summary tables.

option.name: Session time limit (s)
option.desc: A session stops after this many seconds. 0 = no limit.

option.name: Slow call lines per session
option.desc: Most slow-call lines per session.

option.name: Profiler log size limit (KB)
option.desc: Above this size only the final summary is written.

option.name: Engine optimizations
option.desc: All optimizations of the game's code; each has its own switch.

option.name: Animator parameter cache
option.desc: Animator parameter checks of agents and clerks are cached instead of building a list each time.

option.name: Sound preload
option.desc: Sounds played before are loaded ahead at game start, so their first play does not freeze a fight.

option.name: Sound preload: ms per frame
option.desc: Most ms per frame spent preloading sounds.

option.name: Sound preload: sounds kept
option.desc: Most sounds kept loaded; more use more memory.

option.name: Freeze dead bodies
option.desc: Dead agents and clerks stop animating after a short delay and wake up if revived.

option.name: Freeze dead bodies: delay (s)
option.desc: Game seconds after death before a body is frozen.

option.name: Spread mass panic
option.desc: Mass panic starts over several frames instead of one, so the game does not freeze.

option.name: Spread mass panic: ms per frame
option.desc: Most ms per frame spent starting panic.

option.name: Inventory: update visible slots only
option.desc: With the inventory open, slots out of view skip their update.

option.name: Room connection check without a path search
option.desc: Room connection checks skip the full path search; same answers.

option.name: No speed calculation for standing agents
option.desc: Standing agents skip the speed calculation each tick.

option.name: Shared armor textures
option.desc: Agents share armor textures and materials instead of creating new ones on each animation change.

option.name: Cap slow frame step
option.desc: A slow frame runs at most 2-3 game ticks instead of about 16. Below 20 FPS the game runs slower than real time.

option.name: Clerks as pictures at wide zoom
option.desc: With 20 or more clerks at wide zoom, calm clerks are drawn as still pictures.

option.name: Skip enemy search in calm rooms
option.desc: Units skip the enemy search in rooms with only controlled workers.

option.name: Slower agent label refresh
option.desc: Agent names and titles refresh a few times per second instead of every frame.

option.name: Aiming cursor memory fix
option.desc: The aiming cursor frees its old texture.

option.name: E.G.O list opening speed
option.desc: The EGO list keeps its requirement plates between openings.

option.name: Effect pictures in memory
option.desc: Effect pictures keep one copy in memory; identical ones are shared.

option.name: Character mesh memory fix
option.desc: At each day start, character meshes that nothing uses any more are destroyed.

option.name: Prepare special weapon skeletons
option.desc: Special weapon skeletons load at day start, not in the first fight.

option.name: Fewer bubbles after a death
option.desc: Limits speech bubbles per frame after a death.

option.name: Build boss texts gradually
option.desc: Boss texts build over several frames.

option.name: Story character pictures
option.desc: A story picture with duplicate face names loads instead of breaking.

option.name: Child creature removed twice
option.desc: A child creature that is suppressed twice (some mods do it) no longer throws the second time.

option.name: Child creature stuck at an elevator
option.desc: A child creature whose path ends on an elevator no longer throws out of its update; it is handled as for other creatures.

option.name: Riot stick look after unequip
option.desc: After a weapon is unequipped the agent shows and swings the Riot stick instead of One Sin's weapon.

option.name: Screen resolution
option.desc: Click to cycle 16:9 resolutions. Takes effect after Apply.

option.name: Window mode
option.desc: Fullscreen, borderless (instant alt-tab, resolution ignored) or window.

option.name: V-sync
option.desc: Frames wait for the monitor. Off: a bit more FPS below the refresh rate, tearing possible.

option.name: FPS limit
option.desc: Most frames per second. 0 = no limit. Ignored with V-sync.

option.name: Smooth motion (50/25 FPS)
option.desc: Holds 50 FPS, one game tick per frame; drops to 25 when the game cannot keep up. Replaces the FPS limit.

option.name: Texture quality
option.desc: Lower saves video memory; little FPS change.

option.name: Hide off-screen interface
option.desc: World interface outside the view is switched off.

option.name: Hide employee bars from zoom
option.desc: From this camera size the bars, grade, title, buffs and speech of employees are hidden. 0 = never.

option.name: Main camera cache
option.desc: The main camera is found once per frame.

option.name: Spread witness reactions
option.desc: Witness reactions to a death spread over a few ticks; same damage.

option.name: Witness reaction budget (ms)
option.desc: Most ms per tick spent on witness reactions.

option.name: Death speech bubbles per frame
option.desc: Speech bubbles per frame after a death.

option.name: Agent label refreshes per second
option.desc: Label refreshes per second.

option.name: Stop off-screen door animators
option.desc: Door animators stop out of view. A door changed off-screen plays its old transition when seen.

option.name: Path check: verify mode
option.desc: Runs the game's check too and logs differences; no speed gain.

option.name: Skin cache: statistics
option.desc: Logs material, texture and mesh counts every 10 s.

option.name: Bonus pool
option.desc: Equipment and gift bonuses are summed without new objects.

option.name: Department lookup
option.desc: Department lookup creates no garbage.

option.name: Agent animation LOD
option.desc: Zoomed out, agents animate a little less often.

option.name: Skeletons on pause
option.desc: On pause, characters refresh their pose rarely.

option.name: EGO list build
option.desc: The EGO list builds gradually on the preparation screen; the day loads up to twice as fast.

option.name: Custom sprite scaling
option.desc: Custom agent sprites are scaled on the video card at start; full-size copies are freed.

option.name: EGO list opens on ZAYIN
option.desc: The EGO list opens on ZAYIN each day; click ZAYIN again for all grades.

option.name: Fast mod armor loading
option.desc: Mod armor pictures load once into one texture instead of from disk on every use.

option.name: Fast path search
option.desc: Path search without allocations; same paths.

option.name: Fast EGO tabs
option.desc: EGO tabs switch without toggling every slot.

option.name: Dimensional Refraction render
option.desc: The distortion bends the last frame instead of drawing the scene twice.

option.name: Fast abnormality search
option.desc: Abnormality search by id without allocations.

option.name: Notice pool
option.desc: Game notices no longer copy the listener list on each send.

option.name: Silent Orchestra worker list
option.desc: The abnormality reuses its employee list while breached.

option.name: Info window lines
option.desc: The abnormality info window reuses its description lines.

option.name: Font warm-up
option.desc: Info window text sizes are prepared at day start.

option.name: Memory cleaning in quiet moments
option.desc: Memory is cleaned on pause, in the info window and at day end.

option.name: Quiet cleaning threshold (MB)
option.desc: Memory growth in MB before a quiet cleaning.

option.name: Buff name cache
option.desc: Buff search by name without allocations.

option.name: Equipment id cache
option.desc: Equipment ids are not created again on each request.

option.name: HP Awareness
option.desc: No allocations for every employee every frame.

option.name: Quiet log
option.desc: Ordinary log lines are not written; warnings and errors stay.

option.name: Agents outside the view
option.desc: Calm agents out of view stop animating and drawing.

option.name: Clerks outside the view
option.desc: Calm clerks out of view stop animating and drawing. Off while clerk pictures are on.

option.name: Hide ordeal unit bars from zoom
option.desc: From this camera size, bars and names of ordeal units are hidden when 20 or more are out. 0 = never.

option.name: Unit loops without allocations
option.desc: Buff and gift loops of employees and clerks without allocations.

option.name: Employee stats without allocations
option.desc: Reading employee stats does not allocate memory.

option.name: Mod skeleton cache
option.desc: Mod weapon and animation skeletons are parsed once, not on each animation change (10-100 ms each).

option.name: Shared BaseMods file list at start
option.desc: Some mods read the list of all BaseMods files when the game starts (Train Ego Mod: about 3 s). The list is built in the background while other mods load and handed to them. The log compares it with a fresh list after start.

option.name: Abnormality file index
option.desc: Abnormality stat files are found through an index built once instead of searching all mod folders each time. Needs the load guard.

option.name: Skip intro logos
option.desc: The two logo screens before the title are skipped (about 12 s).

option.name: Fast path search: verify mode
option.desc: Runs the game's search too and logs differences; no speed gain.

option.name: Agent pictures: one copy
option.desc: Agent animation pictures keep one copy in memory. Mods that read them may break.

option.name: Abnormality pictures: one copy
option.desc: Abnormality pictures keep one copy in memory from day start. Needs Agent pictures: one copy.

option.name: Agent animations on first use
option.desc: Agent animation pictures load on first use: faster start, a short stutter later.

option.name: ChildHood: cat animations on first appearance
option.desc: Cat animations load when a cat first appears: faster start, a short stutter later. Experimental.

option.name: White and Black Bird: first move
option.desc: A black bird that escapes no longer throws on its first move.

option.name: LCPD Pinocchio: first move
option.desc: A puppet that escapes no longer throws on its first move.

option.name: Rotten Whale Fall: bone fish
option.desc: A bone fish without its animation no longer throws when it appears.

option.name: Yin Yang Dragon Scale
option.desc: The abnormality without its animation no longer throws when the facility loads.

option.name: Flower of Eternity: attack at day end
option.desc: A flower attack that lands at the end of the day no longer throws and stops other animation events of that frame.

option.name: Isomer: damage effect
option.desc: The damage effect picture is read from the mod folder (the mod looks for a folder with another name).

option.name: ToyFactory: full error text
option.desc: An error that the mod's notice guard catches is written in full, with its stack, to ToyFactoryError.txt and once per kind to the NailOptimization log.

option.name: Invalidum: departments at day end
option.desc: Lighting the departments back up no longer throws when a creature is outside every passage.

option.name: Invalidum: sounds
option.desc: Its sounds are read from the mod folder (the mod looks for a folder with another name).

option.name: LCPD Pinocchio: removed target
option.desc: An attack on a target removed at the end of the day no longer throws.

option.name: Lady in Rain: drawing
option.desc: Drawing stops when its view or painting tool is gone instead of throwing every frame.

option.name: QiuNiu: circle
option.desc: Its circle no longer throws on units that are not agents, officers, creatures or children.

option.name: Mephisto: debuff on officers
option.desc: Its debuff on an officer or another non-agent no longer throws when that unit is hit.

option.name: Hookah Caterpillar: animation
option.desc: Its animation is found even when the mod list lookup fails, instead of the creature staying without animation.

option.name: Rotten Whale Fall: tail pull
option.desc: Its tail skips the pull while the target is between rooms instead of throwing every frame.

option.name: Charlotte: damage between rooms
option.desc: Taking damage between rooms no longer throws.

option.name: Alleyway Watchdog: area hit
option.desc: Its area hit no longer stops when it kills someone in the room.

option.name: PuLao: endless damage chain
option.desc: Its attack near a music creature no longer repeats itself without end and closes the game; each creature joins the chain once.

option.name: It Goes By The Name of Dream: empty worker
option.desc: A NothingWorker object that the mod created without initializing it no longer throws an error every frame.

option.name: LCPD Pinocchio: escape tick
option.desc: Picking its defence target and chasing a target that just died no longer throw every tick.

option.name: Invalidum: flooded passage
option.desc: The flooded passage no longer stops when a unit in it dies or leaves during the check.

option.name: Homeless Beast: department hit
option.desc: Its hit on the whole department no longer stops when it kills someone.

option.name: YaZi: death animation
option.desc: Suppression without a death animation no longer throws every frame; the creature is hidden as in vanilla.

option.name: Black Bird: death animation
option.desc: Suppression of the black bird without a death animation no longer throws every frame; it goes straight to the pose it takes after that animation.

option.name: Rotten Whale Fall: roaming
option.desc: Without a target it keeps one roaming destination instead of choosing a new one every tick and turning back and forth.

option.name: QianRu: EGO take-back
option.desc: Taking back its EGO from the inventory no longer stops after the first removed item.

option.name: Cauldron: lure
option.desc: Luring when every candidate is dead no longer throws; the lure is skipped.

option.name: Candeloro: ribbons
option.desc: A ribbon whose end was destroyed no longer throws every frame; it stays where it was until removed.

option.name: Cloud9: panic outside rooms
option.desc: An agent panicking while the escaped cloud is between rooms no longer throws.

option.name: YaZi: breach without request window
option.desc: A breach before its request window was ever opened no longer throws.

option.name: Grungly: lure
option.desc: A lure whose target no longer qualifies, or with no agent left to lure, no longer throws every tick; the lure stops.

option.name: Black Bird: hallway hit
option.desc: Its hit on the hallway no longer stops when it kills someone there. Needs 12Harmony.

option.name: Effect pictures on first show
option.desc: Effect pictures are freed at start and load when first shown.

option.name: Ordeal does not carry over to the next day
option.desc: An ordeal still running when the day ends (retry, return to title) no longer continues in the next day.

option.name: Save load: ignore equipment no mod defines
option.desc: A mod that grants equipment no mod defines gets nothing instead of an error that stops the save load (Sephirah data).

option.name: CENSORED Remake: dead children removed
option.desc: Summoned children that died are removed 3 s later instead of at the end of the day, so the day no longer slows down with every summon.

option.name: Colored Fixer: stuck agent after Kali EGO
option.desc: An agent no longer stays stunned and out of control after Kali's EGO ends; EGO change and teleport effects no longer repeat on later animations.

option.name: Camera zoom range read once
option.desc: The camera reads its zoom range once instead of rebuilding the list of open departments several times per frame.

option.name: Skip ordeal update without ordeals
option.desc: The ordeal update is skipped while no ordeal is running, instead of creating a list every tick.

option.name: Mouse hover without new lists
option.desc: The check of what is under the mouse cursor reuses its lists instead of creating new ones every frame.

option.name: Mod option sliders save once
option.desc: Dragging a mod option slider writes the options file once, 0.5 s after the last change, instead of on every step.

option.name: Missing gift sprite looked up once
option.desc: A gift sprite that no mod provides is looked up once instead of in every mod folder on each appearance update.

option.name: Portraits looked up once
option.desc: Vanilla abnormality portraits and missing custom portraits are looked up once per scene instead of on every call.

option.name: Mod weapon and gift scripts found through one list
option.desc: Weapons and gifts find their mod script through a list built once instead of scanning the types of every mod each time.

option.name: Mod weapon scripts without a game namesake
option.desc: With the script list on: a mod weapon whose script class has no game class of the same name gets its script. The game gives it none, so its special effect never runs.
